page.overview:
Who is Bogged?

Bedrock Edition: depending on proximity Easy and Normal: - , Hard: - , Java Edition: depending on proximity Easy: - Normal: - Hard: - Melee Easy and Normal: Hard:

A bogged is a variant of a skeleton found in swamp biomes. It is an undead hostile mob that can shoot arrows of Poison.

Bogged naturally spawn within the swamp biome, similar to how strays spawn in snowy biomes. Bogged may also be spawned from ranged mob trial spawners in trial chambers.

Bogged behave very similarly to skeletons. They will attack nearby players by shooting arrows tipped with poison at them. Notably, bogged are much slower to reload their bows than normal skeletons, taking 3.5 seconds rather than 2.0, and also have less health.
